# Bar Chart Visualisation

# Fetch the Preprocessed data
```{r}
#| label: fetch-preprocessed-data-bar
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)
library(readr)
library(forcats)
library(scales)
library(stringr)

preprocessed_data <- read_csv(export_path)
```

# Filter Rows
```{r}
#| label: filter-bar-country-data
#| message: false

bar_country_data <- preprocessed_data |>
  filter(
    str_squish(country) != "World",
    !is.na(export_value),
    !is.na(export_quantity),
    !is.na(geo_region)
  )
```

# Select top exporters
```{r}
#| label: prepare-top30-bar-data
#| message: false

bar_top30 <- bar_country_data |>
  slice_max(
    order_by = export_value,
    n = 30,
    with_ties = FALSE
  )
```

# Chart Labels
```{r}
#| label: format-bar-labels
#| message: false

bar_top30 <- bar_top30 |>
  mutate(
    export_value_usd_billions = export_value / 1000,
    export_quantity_million_tonnes = export_quantity / 1000,
    export_value_label = label_dollar(
      prefix = "US$",
      suffix = "B",
      accuracy = 0.1
    )(export_value_usd_billions),
    export_quantity_label = label_number(
      accuracy = 0.1,
      suffix = " Mt"
    )(export_quantity_million_tonnes),
    chart_label = str_c(
      export_value_label,
      " | ",
      export_quantity_label
    ),
    country = fct_reorder(country, export_value)
  )
```

# Okabe Ito Palette
```{r}
#| label: define-bar-region-palette
#| message: false

okabe_ito_palette <- c(
  "#E69F00", # orange
  "#56B4E9", # sky blue
  "#009E73", # bluish green
  "#F0E442", # yellow
  "#0072B2", # blue
  "#D55E00", # vermillion
  "#CC79A7", # reddish purple
  "#999999" # grey
)

region_levels <- sort(unique(bar_country_data$geo_region))

if (length(region_levels) > length(okabe_ito_palette)) {
  stop("There are more geographic regions than available Okabe-Ito colours.")
}

region_palette <- set_names(
  okabe_ito_palette[seq_along(region_levels)],
  region_levels
)
```

# Set Styling Constants
```{r}
#| label: set-bar-chart-styling
#| message: false

bar_base_text_size <- 14
bar_y_axis_text_size <- 11
bar_legend_text_size <- 11
bar_legend_title_size <- 12
bar_label_size <- 3.4
bar_right_padding <- 0.28
```

# Build the bar chart
```{r}
#| label: build-bar-chart-value-region
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| fig-height: 10
#| fig-width: 15

gg_bar_value_region <- ggplot(
  bar_top30,
  aes(
    x = export_value_usd_billions,
    y = country,
    fill = geo_region
  )
) +
  geom_col(width = 0.72) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = chart_label),
    hjust = -0.08,
    size = bar_label_size,
    color = "grey25"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = region_palette,
    name = "Geographic Region"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    labels = label_dollar(
      prefix = "US$",
      suffix = "B"
    ),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, bar_right_padding))
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Agricultural Export Value (USD Billions)",
    y = "Country / Reporting Economy",
    title = "Top 30 Agricultural Exporters by Export Value in 2024",
    subtitle = "Bars are ranked by export value and coloured by geographic region; direct labels show export value and recorded export volume.",
    caption = str_wrap(
      "Export volume is shown in million tonnes (Mt) for product groups measured by physical quantity. Aggregate rows such as World are excluded. European Union is treated as a reporting economy in the WTO dataset.",
      width = 110
    )
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = bar_base_text_size) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    plot.title.position = "plot",
    plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = bar_y_axis_text_size),
    legend.text = element_text(size = bar_legend_text_size),
    legend.title = element_text(size = bar_legend_title_size),
    plot.margin = margin(10, 40, 16, 10)
  )

gg_bar_value_region
```

# Top Exporters by Region
```{r}
#| label: prepare-top-exporters-by-region
#| message: false

regional_top_exporters <- bar_country_data |>
  group_by(geo_region) |>
  slice_max(
    order_by = export_value,
    n = 5,
    with_ties = FALSE
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    export_value_usd_billions = export_value / 1000,
    export_value_label = scales::label_dollar(
      prefix = "US$",
      suffix = "B",
      accuracy = 0.1
    )(export_value_usd_billions),
    country_region_label = str_c(country, "___", geo_region),
    country_region_label = fct_reorder(country_region_label, export_value)
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: bar-chart-top-exporters-by-region
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| fig-height: 10
#| fig-width: 15

gg_bar_regional_leaders <- ggplot(
  regional_top_exporters,
  aes(
    x = export_value_usd_billions,
    y = country_region_label,
    fill = geo_region
  )
) +
  geom_col(width = 0.72) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = export_value_label),
    hjust = -0.08,
    size = 3.3,
    color = "grey25",
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    vars(geo_region),
    scales = "free_y"
  ) +
  scale_y_discrete(
    labels = \(label) str_remove(label, "___.*$")
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = region_palette,
    name = "Geographic Region"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    labels = scales::label_dollar(
      prefix = "US$",
      suffix = "B"
    ),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.28))
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Agricultural Export Value (USD Billions)",
    y = "Country / Reporting Economy",
    title = "Top Agricultural Exporters Within Each Geographic Region",
    subtitle = "Each panel shows the five highest-value reporting economies in that region.",
    caption = str_wrap(
      "Faceting by region reduces the dominance of the largest global exporters and makes within-region comparison easier.",
      width = 110
    )
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title.position = "plot",
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    plot.margin = margin(10, 30, 16, 10)
  )

gg_bar_regional_leaders
```

# Which countries are more important by value than by volume?
```{r}
#| label: prepare-divergence-data
#| message: false

divergence_data <- bar_country_data |>
  mutate(
    value_rank = min_rank(desc(export_value)),
    quantity_rank = min_rank(desc(export_quantity))
  ) |>
  semi_join(
    bar_top30 |> select(country),
    by = "country"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    rank_gap = quantity_rank - value_rank,
    rank_gap_direction = case_when(
      rank_gap > 0 ~ "Ranks higher by value",
      rank_gap < 0 ~ "Ranks higher by volume",
      TRUE ~ "Same rank"
    ),
    rank_gap_label = case_when(
      rank_gap > 0 ~ str_c("+", rank_gap),
      TRUE ~ as.character(rank_gap)
    ),
    country = fct_reorder(country, rank_gap)
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: bar-chart-divergence-view
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| fig-height: 10
#| fig-width: 15

gg_bar_divergence <- ggplot(
  divergence_data,
  aes(
    x = rank_gap,
    y = country,
    fill = rank_gap_direction
  )
) +
  geom_col(width = 0.72) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    linewidth = 0.5,
    color = "grey50"
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      label = rank_gap_label,
      hjust = if_else(rank_gap >= 0, -0.15, 1.15)
    ),
    size = 3.3,
    color = "grey25",
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Ranks higher by value" = "#0072B2",
      "Ranks higher by volume" = "#D55E00",
      "Same rank" = "#999999"
    ),
    name = "Rank Difference"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.15, 0.15))
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Quantity Rank - Value Rank",
    y = "Country / Reporting Economy",
    title = "Which Top Exporters Rank Higher by Value Than by Volume?",
    subtitle = "Positive values mean the exporter ranks higher by export value; negative values mean it ranks higher by export quantity.",
    caption = str_wrap(
      "Ranks are calculated across all reporting economies in the processed dataset, then shown for the top 30 exporters by value.",
      width = 110
    )
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    plot.title.position = "plot",
    plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
    plot.margin = margin(10, 30, 16, 10)
  )

gg_bar_divergence
```
